mapper.select: select id,member_id memberId,mms_merchant_id merchantId,status,pay_type payType,aftersale_status aftersaleStatus, product_quantity productQuantity,order_sn orderSn,biz_type bizType,payment_transaction_id transactionId, del_flag delFlag,entitlement_days entitlementDays,entitlement_max_usage entitlementMaxUsage, pay_amount payAmount,order_total_amount orderTotalAmount,product_total_amount productTotalAmount, delivery_fee deliveryFee,tax_fee taxFee,points_amount pointsAmount,coupon_amount couponAmount,payment_time paymentTime from oms_order where order_sn=#{number} and biz_type='workshop_module_v1' for update

select id,order_id orderId,product_id productId,sku_id skuId,quantity,aftersale_order_id aftersaleOrderId, aftersale_status aftersaleStatus,price from oms_order_item where order_id=#{orderId} order by id for update

select order_line_id orderLineId,order_id orderId,buyer_member_id buyerMemberId,product_id productId,sku_id skuId, amount_minor amountMinor,currency,provider_app_id providerAppId,provider_merchant_id providerMerchantId, snapshot_json snapshotJson,snapshot_hash snapshotHash,state,source_content sourceContent,terms_document termsDocument,frozen_at frozenAt from w18_paid_order_line_snapshot where order_line_id=#{lineId} for update

select license_id licenseId,order_line_id orderLineId,order_id orderId,buyer_member_id buyerMemberId, provider_transaction_id providerTransactionId,source_event_id sourceEventId,snapshot_hash snapshotHash,state, paid_at paidAt,issued_at issuedAt from w18_paid_license where order_line_id=#{lineId} for update

select o.order_sn from w18_paid_license l join oms_order o on o.id=l.order_id and o.member_id=l.buyer_member_id where l.license_id=#{licenseId} and l.buyer_member_id=#{actor} and o.biz_type='workshop_module_v1' and o.del_flag=0
select id from ums_member where id=#{actor} and status=1 and del_flag=0
select id from ums_member where id=#{actor} and status=1 and del_flag=0 for update
mapper.update: update oms_order set status=1,pay_type=1,payment_transaction_id=#{transactionId},payment_time=#{paidAt},update_time=now() where id=#{orderId} and biz_type='workshop_module_v1' and status=0 and pay_type=0 and payment_time is null and payment_transaction_id is null and del_flag=0 and aftersale_status=1
